1 جَلَمَهُ , (S, Msb, K,) aor.
جَلِمَ , (Msb, K,) inf. n. جَلْمٌ, (S, Msb,) He cut it, or cut it off; (S, Msb, K;) [like جَرَمَهُ.] ―
-b2- He shore it, or sheared it; namely, wool, (Msb, K,) and hair, with the جَلَمَانِ, (Msb,) or جَلَم. (TA.) And جَلَمْتُ مِنْهُ I took [or clipped somewhat] from it; namely, wool; like جَرَمْتُ. (S in art. جرم.) And جَلَمَ الشَّاةَ He shore, or sheared, the sheep or goat. (Har p. 190.) ―
-b3- جَلَمَ الجَزُورَ, (S, K,) inf. n. as above, (S,) He took the flesh that was on the bones of the slaughtered camel; (S, K;) as also ↓ اجتلمهُ . (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
